# Password hashes for the hash/argon2id/verify and hash/bcrypt/verify benchmarks.
#
# Changing this file invalidates every historical number for the benchmarks that
# read it, because the cost of verifying a hash is set by the parameters written
# into the hash itself. A verify against a cost 12 bcrypt hash and a verify
# against a cost 10 one are different operations, and comparing them across a
# release says the framework got faster when nothing about it changed. If a
# parameter here has to move, reset the baseline in the same commit and say so
# in the message.
#
# The password behind all of them is "correct horse battery staple". These are
# fixtures rather than secrets: the password is written here in the open, and
# nothing outside these benchmarks reads the file.
#
# One line per hash: the name, whitespace, and the encoded hash.

argon2id	$argon2id$v=19$m=19456,t=2,p=1$IzFnO4mF1K7dSNvdR/jmZQ$U5Rc73Exjy0D9f1z4GvREUmZfcepzdFTs+XF70EyjZY
bcrypt	$2a$12$QjmfX.JbWEqCEM..04mZfOKlp.TlJP002lgmkjhFk0PPPZa5A7esK
